name: Peirika-Beena
source:
Job: Warrior
Origin: Grassland City Lumiel

A cheerful woman who is the mood maker of the party and actively interacts with others. She is the type to act on intuition.
A warrior who confuses enemies with swift movements and unleashes a flurry of attacks when the enemy is vulnerable.
Her attractive physique is appealing, and she is popular with both men and women.
